name: Michael Seibel
person: Michael Seibel, Group Partner at Y Combinator, former CEO of the core YC accelerator (2016-2024), co-founder/CEO of Justin.tv→Twitch and Socialcam. Blog at michaelseibel.com, co-hosts the "Dalton & Michael" YC podcast/video series with Dalton Caldwell. NOT any other Michael Seibel.

notes.attribution: He co-hosts the "Dalton & Michael" YC series with Dalton Caldwell: distinguish his words from Dalton's.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (9 michaelseibel.com essays, 3 YC Startup Library talks, the Building Product full transcript, 5 Dalton & Michael episodes, SaaStr 2025 pitch guide).
1. Walk michaelseibel.com/blog for any essay not yet cited, check the full archive index.
2. Walk the YC Startup Library (ycombinator.com/library) for more Michael Seibel talks not yet cited.
3. Find more "Dalton & Michael" podcast/video episodes (YC's YouTube channel, Spotify) beyond the 5 already known, prioritize ones with substantial Seibel-specific content (not just Dalton).
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the 5 already known (Invest Like the Best EP.190, Wharton FinTech "Lessons from 5,000 Entrepreneurs", Black Founders AMA, SaaStr 2025, the Justin.tv/Socialcam origin-story pieces).
1. Any 2025-2026 podcast/interview appearances discussing YC's current strategy, AI's effect on startups, or his own founder journey in more depth.
2. Any talk/interview specifically about his time as YC CEO (2016-2024) and the transition back to Group Partner in 2024, what changed, why he stepped down.
3. Any interview about the Twitch/Justin.tv or Socialcam acquisitions with concrete detail not yet captured.
Return exact URLs, priority-marked, 8-12 items with transcripts preferred.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} beyond the one already known (the "negatives of YC" Medium compilation).
1. Any additional critique of YC's model/curriculum under his leadership as CEO (2016-2024), founder complaints, equity terms critique, batch-size/scale critique.
2. Critiques of the "launch fast, talk to users" doctrine from founders in deep-tech/biotech/regulated industries where it doesn't apply.
3. Any critique specifically of his "access not talent" / diversity framing, or push-back on his 2019 "move to the Bay Area" stance.
Return exact URLs, type=critique, 6-10 items.
